leadText:
Verona (Japanese: コノハ Konoha) is a character of the day who appeared in Promoting Healthy Tangrowth!. She is a who watches over a forest near Lake Acuity.

Verona first approached and , warning them not to enter the forest because of a that uses . She offered to help them locate their missing friend , who had already gone into the forest after her runaway . During their search, the aforementioned Tangrowth attacked them and used Absorb on , sapping its energy. Strangely, after it took Grotle's energy, it left behind a Sitrus Berry to help it recover.

Verona eventually discovered that the energy Tangrowth was taking from the Pokémon was being used to help a dying tree. Tangrowth never meant any harm to the Pokémon, which was why it would leave behind either an or a Sitrus Berry so that they would get better. After the tree became healthier, Verona decided to work with Tangrowth in order to protect the forest.
